It is a highly sought-after and innovative overdrive circuit. The BYOC Silver Pony version uses true bypass, meaning it does not have a buffered bypass. The enclosure is painted or screen printed and comes with a red LED and brown 1400 style knobs. It’s worth noting that as of June 15, 2020, version 2.1 of the Silver Pony has been released. The BYOC Silver Pony is documented as being based on the silver-era Klon Centaur.

Unlike BYOC's usual preference for true bypass on cloned circuits, the Silver Pony retains the original-style pop-free buffered bypass system.

The reviewed source identifies the silver-era Centaur basis. No numbered BYOC revision is established in the reviewed source.

The archive records the Klon Centaur circuit family as the design reference without adding unsupported component or voicing claims.

Build Your Own Clone browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive overdrive browse by enclosure pedal Special categories Classics Build Your Own Clone Silver Pony Published on July 31, 2014 Build Your Own Clone overdrive pedal Classics Information The BYOC Silver Pony is based on the silver-era Klon Centaur. Normally, we remove buffered bypass from the circuits we clone in favor of true bypass, but the buffer in this circuit is actually very nice, so we kept it.
